  • Constructor Details

    • NativeResult

      private NativeResult(CalibratedPvtModel model, boolean tuned, MaterialBalancePvtHistory.Path path, String reference, PvtSeparatorPath separator, DepletionSnapshot[] snapshots, PvtSeparatorPath.Result[] retained, PvtSeparatorPath.Result[] withdrawn, ConstantVolumeDepletion.FixedCellResult fixedCell)
      Freezes actual completed protocol evidence.
      Parameters:
      model - original/tuned immutable checkpoints
      tuned - selected checkpoint
      path - actual CVD/DLE protocol
      reference - whole-experiment identity
      separator - immutable separator and final product basis
      snapshots - native pressure-ordered states
      retained - products of each retained cell
      withdrawn - interval products, null for a zero withdrawal
      fixedCell - explicit occupied-volume reference, null for the existing laboratory routes

  • Method Details

    • hasFixedCellReference

      public boolean hasFixedCellReference()
      Tests whether this is an explicitly initial-occupied-volume-referenced experiment.
      Returns:
      true only for an explicit fixed-cell replay, never for an inferred upper-dew reference

    • getFixedCellReference

      public ConstantVolumeDepletion.FixedCellResult getFixedCellReference()
      Returns explicit initial reference conditions and completed immutable cell states.
      Returns:
      the initial occupied-volume reference, not a dew-point measurement
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this result used an existing laboratory route
